categories.name: Motors
categories.summary: Electric drive and sync motors. The first sound-synchronous motor for Bolex cameras was manufactured in 1965 by Perfectone of Bienne, Switzerland.

categories.name: Cases
categories.summary: Carrying cases, including the Bolex Aluminum Carrying Case — "strong enough to stand on" — sized for an H camera with zoom lens, Matte Box and Unimotor attached.

categories.name: Tripods and Grips
categories.summary: Includes the Reporter Grip (1962) for H-model cameras with quick-set base attachment and fingertip release; the Declic H grip for flat-base H models; and an 11 oz monopod introduced in 1961 for the B, C and D models.

categories.name: Matte Box
categories.summary: Introduced in 1962 for any H camera; produced effects with masks and served as filter holder and lens shade. Dedicated page pending recovery.

categories.name: Miscellaneous
categories.summary: Aftermarket items and modifications alongside Paillard-manufactured accessories.
